$comment: Version vocabulary for apps/tags/title_fix.py. 'mix_descriptors' are words that may sit before 'Mix' without naming a remixer ('Club Mix', 'Techno Mix', 'Extended VIP Mix'); any other word makes '<Name> Mix' a named remix. Lists derived from trackparse spec/data/descriptors.json, version-keywords.json (typeCapableModifiers) and genres.json (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Maksim Maksimov, https://github.com/4matic/trackparse, commit a19642df2), plus local additions: acid, afro, disco, melodic, mixed, nu disco, organic, peak time. See NOTICE.
